verdict.rationale: Morph is documented only as a hosted API at api.morphllm.com. Its dedicated endpoints are explicitly provisioned and operated by Morph, so they are managed capacity rather than self-hosting. Serving open-weight models and running WarpGrep for local search do not amount to self-hosting the core product, and nothing in the pack shows a deployable or on-prem distribution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
